"Success pehle ki tayari pe depend karti."
Momentum tumhara dost hai.
Vision bina action, daydream.
Maine sapne nahi dekhe, mehnat ki hai.
Success consistency se banti hai.
"Success ke liye apni kamar todna nahi."
Self-belief self-control banati hai.
Aise kaam karo jaise rukna nahi chahte.
"Motivation aati-jati; discipline rehti."
Ye mat chaho ki sab easy ho; chaho ki tum behtar bano.
Earth pe sabse strong force human will.
Waves rok nahi sakte, surf seekh sakte.
Attitude height decide karta hai.
